sources.title: GitHub - Edge0-AI/Audio8_TTS: SOTA-Class TTS at Compact Scale
sources.snippet: 🚀 How small a zero-shot cloning TTS can be? Meet our latest release, Audio8-TTS-0.1B: a powerful, compact, and even portable text-to-speech model! This repository provides the audio8_tts Preview checkpoint, Hugging Face remote code, inference tools, and an independent SFT pipeline for multilingual speech generation and zero-shot voice cloning.
